component.name: 7zipl
component.summary: 7-Zip File Manager with a native GTK 4 interface

description.p: 7zipl is the 7-Zip File Manager for Linux. It keeps 7-Zip's own engine and its window layout, dialogs and keyboard shortcuts, with a plain GTK 4 interface that follows the system theme.

ul.li: Browse folders and archives, including archives inside archives
Create 7z, zip, tar, wim, gzip, bzip2 and xz archives with 7-Zip's compression options and AES-256 encryption
Extract and test 7z, zip, rar, tar, iso, cab, dmg, wim, rpm, deb and many more formats
Add, delete and rename files inside an archive
CRC32, CRC64, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, BLAKE2sp and other checksums
